build_model_from_registry: build a model by name using the MODELS_REGISTRY factory function with args and kwargs
register_new_model: register a new model constructor in the MODELS_REGISTRY so it can be built by name
build_model_with_kwargs: build a registered model instance passing keyword arguments to the model constructor
review_MODELS_REGISTRY: review the MODELS_REGISTRY to see which model constructors are currently registered
summarize_build_model: summarize the build_model function that instantiates registered torch.nn.Module models by name
